name: The Mentor
tagline: Someone else once showed you the way
wisdomRoot: The bodhisattva vow — having crossed, you wait at the threshold for the next one. Lift as you climb.
bio: The one who brings new people in. Spots whoever's standing at the edge and waves them over.
sceneStory: In the middle of an empty dark field stands a single freestanding door, warm light pouring out around its edges. A figure leans into it holding it wide open, one arm stretched out, waving a hesitant newcomer in from the dark.
assignments: Hold the door you just came through
Lead others down the divine path
